title: TD-14 external-dependency handling
context: check_ticket_set.py flags a depends_on pointing at an existing tracker issue as DANGLING_DEPENDENCY, while plan_posting.py silently skips the same external dep. The agreed behaviour: an external/tracker ref (e.g. PROJ-123) is valid, not dangling. Question is how to converge the two scripts.

options.label: Extract one canonical helper (is-external-ref) both scripts call
Fix each script to the same behaviour without a shared helper

rationale: RULE-04a1 one canonical helper for is-external-ref
